posts.cooked:
As a reminder, the F5 general prerequisite conditions apply:

First, the Prime Wardens (all variant members) must be defeated by Progeny anywhere other than Rook City or Megalopolis. Then, Dark Watch (all variant members) must by defeated by Progeny in Rook City. Then, the Freedom Five (non-variant members) must be defeated by Progeny in Rook City.

If you completed these games already (since F5 Bunker was made available), you don't have to do it again.

Right, she gets severely messed up in the Progeny battle.  Her needing to get incapped is a strong possibility.

If there's a card requirement, I'm thinking less her one-shots and more her Bursts. Maybe she has to have them all in her trash.  On the other hand, F5 Tachyon is all about removing Bursts from her trash–having to end the game with zero bursts in the trash would be painful to try but it's worth considering.  Although technically if she's incapped, she has no bursts in her trash, so one could try both of those at once.

F5 Tachyon also does a lot of ping damage, so she might have to play all her damage cards, or possibly just Nimble Strike, Accelerated Assault, and Hypersonic Assault (the 1-damage ones).
